# Grass grows back from below

<!-- STEP id="not-tip" -->
## Not from the cut top

Look at a blade of grass a few days after it is cut. The cut end at the top stays flat and does not grow a new pointed tip, yet the blade is taller than before.

<!-- STEP id="from-base" -->
## From near the base

The new growth comes from lower down, near the base, where a zone of dividing cells is left after cutting or grazing. These cells keep making new cells, so the blade is pushed up from below.

**Grass grows back from dividing cells near its base, not from its cut top.**
